turns.question: What was our repeat purchase rate from 1 to 10 October 2026: of the customers who bought in that time, what share bought more than once?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no repeat-purchase-rate metric, so I can't give that share. The closest figures for 1 to 10 October 2026 are 10 repeat customers (customers with two or more orders in all) and 17 active customers (distinct customers with a non-cancelled order placed in that period). Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
